title: Quoting Jeremy Morrell

body:
My hypothesis is that there is a new opportunity for Extensible Software on the web . LLMs radically lower the cost of authoring extensions, and modern sandbox primitives lower the deployment cost and provide good security boundaries. We can build our app as a solid, accountable core, and allow users to safely extend it in many directions by having LLMs fill in the missing pieces. We can give our users super powers.

— Jeremy Morrell , Extensible Software in the age of LLMs

Tags: sandboxing , llms , ai , generative-ai
summaryZh: 文章探讨了“大模型时代的可扩展软件”这一新机会。作者指出大模型大幅降低了编写软件扩展的成本，结合现代沙箱的安全边界，开发者能够构建出色的核心应用，并让用户利用大模型安全地向各个方向扩展功能。原始信息显示：My hypothesis is that there is a new opportunity for Extensible Software on the web . LLMs radically lower the cost of authoring extensions, and modern sandbox primitives lower the deployment cost and provide good security boundaries. We can build our app as a solid, accountable core, and allow users to safely extend it in many directions by having LLMs fill。该消息由Simon Willison发布，主题为“Quoting Jeremy Morrell”。其重要性主要体现在：分析了在大模型时代，低成本扩展和沙箱基元如何赋能可扩展软件的新架构。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
